stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the API price of the 5.6 series

key_facts.fact: On September 22, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, extending the GPT-6 generation that began with GPT-6 Astra earlier in September.
key_facts.excerpt: Earlier this month, OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra... Now, the lab is expanding the GPT-6 generation with updated versions of the smaller Sol and Luna models.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI cut API prices for Sol and Luna by 50% versus GPT-5.6 promotional pricing, crediting more efficient caching and inference.
key_facts.excerpt: We've also made caching and inference more efficient, and we're passing the savings directly to you: 50% lower API prices for Sol and Luna compared with GPT-5.6 promotional pricing.

key_facts.fact: Sol targets complex tasks like coding; Luna targets high-volume tasks such as summarizing documents, extracting information or answering quick questions.
key_facts.excerpt: Sol is designed for complex tasks like coding, while OpenAI says Luna is more appropriate for clerical work — "high-volume tasks with a clear goal, like summarizing documents, extracting information, or answering quick questions."

key_facts.fact: OpenAI says that on its internal factuality evaluation GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as its predecessor, reaching Astra-level reliability at much lower cost.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as its predecessor, reaching Astra-level reliability at much lower cost.

key_facts.fact: The launch came about 90 minutes after Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, and OpenAI claims Sol and Luna beat Anthropic's Fable and Opus models on tasks.
key_facts.excerpt: Notably, Anthropic released a new version of Opus 5.5 just 90 minutes before OpenAI's release, reflecting the intense competition between the two companies.

key_facts.fact: Both models are rolling out in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users and in the API; Free and Go users can try GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6 Sol and Luna roll out today in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Both are also available in the API. Free and Go users can try GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app.

key_facts.fact: On September 23, OpenAI said ChatGPT Voice can now be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna and use plugins like email, calendar and Slack.
key_facts.excerpt: ChatGPT Voice can now: Use plugins like your email, calendar, and Slack. Be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, which designs voices from prompts and clones from 30 seconds

key_facts.fact: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS on September 23, 2026, calling them its most expressive audio generation models yet.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.

key_facts.fact: Flash TTS lets users create voices from scratch via natural-language prompts across more than 100 languages and dialects, and offers a library of 2,000+ production-ready voices.
key_facts.excerpt: create bespoke voices from scratch by customizing role, accent and voice characteristics across more than 100 languages and dialects... Access 2,000+ production-ready voices

key_facts.fact: The model can replicate a voice from a 30-second audio sample, backed by consent verification, SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials.
key_facts.excerpt: Recreate consistent vocal profiles from just a 30-second audio sample... backed by built-in consent verification, SynthID watermarking, and C2PA credentials

key_facts.fact: Users must supply a verbal consent recording from the voice owner, which the system checks against the reference speaker before creating the voice.
key_facts.excerpt: Google says users must supply a verbal consent recording from the voice owner, and the system checks that it matches the reference speaker before creating the voice.

key_facts.fact: Google says the models took top positions in blind human-preference tests on Voice Arena in languages including Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Hindi and Mexican Spanish.
key_facts.excerpt: In blind human preference evaluations on Voice Arena, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS secure top positions amongst competitors in key global languages, including Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Vietnamese, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), Mexican Spanish and Hindi.

key_facts.fact: The models are available in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook and Google Vids.
key_facts.excerpt: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

stories.headline: OpenAI gives Ukraine free access to its Daybreak cyber-defense program and GPT-5.6 Sol

key_facts.fact: OpenAI will share its AI cyber-defense system Daybreak for free with Ukraine's government to help protect civilian infrastructure such as hospitals and power plants.
key_facts.excerpt: The tech giant OpenAI will share its AI cyber defence system Daybreak for free with the Ukraine government to help it protect civilian infrastructure, like hospitals and power plants, from cyber-attacks.

key_facts.fact: Under the deal Ukraine gets access to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the deal, Ukraine will get access to OpenAI's advanced GPT 5.6 Sol model - a rival to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable.

key_facts.fact: The agreement was announced Wednesday (September 23) at OpenAI's New York office; OpenAI said it is pledging over $1 billion in subsidized tokens to support the initiative.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement, announced Wednesday at OpenAI's New York office... OpenAI said it is also pledging over $1 billion in subsidized tokens to support the initiative.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine plans to use the tools for incident response, threat triage, login analysis, system inventory, code analysis and vulnerability validation, per consul general Dmytro Kushneruk.
key_facts.excerpt: Dmytro Kushneruk, consul general of Ukraine in San Francisco, outlined how the tools would be used for cybersecurity automation, including functions such as incident response, threat triaging, login analysis, inventorying systems, code analysis and validating vulnerabilities.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI national security policy head Sasha Baker said the company feels urgency to strike similar deals with other governments before such tools proliferate to attackers.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's national security policy head, Sasha Baker, said the company felt "urgency" to try to strike similar agreements with other governments and industries.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is working with Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation; Ukraine's CERT-UA handled nearly 6,000 cyber incidents in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: It is working with Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation... Ukraine's CERT-UA handled nearly 6,000 cyber incidents in 2025.

stories.headline: Amazon lets sellers run their stores from Anthropic's Claude via a new Seller Assistant plugin

key_facts.fact: At its Accelerate seller conference on September 23, Amazon launched a Selling Partner plugin that brings Seller Assistant into Amazon Quick and, in beta, Anthropic's Claude.
key_facts.excerpt: A new plugin brings Seller Assistant's intelligence into the AI tools sellers already use, launching first with Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic's Claude

key_facts.fact: The plugin lets sellers check inventory, adjust prices and update listings without opening Seller Central; connecting Claude takes about 60 seconds with no coding.
key_facts.excerpt: The idea is to let sellers check inventory, adjust prices and update listings without opening Seller Central... Amazon says connecting Claude takes about 60 seconds and no coding.

key_facts.fact: Amazon says 90% of its selling partners already use third-party AI tools; Seller Assistant reaches over 90% of sellers worldwide, who accept its recommendations more than 90% of the time.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, 90% of Amazon selling partners already use third-party AI tools to run their businesses.

key_facts.fact: Seller Assistant gains persistent memory of each seller's pricing patterns and inventory cycles, plus background workflows that can act on restocking and pricing with seller-defined guardrails.
key_facts.excerpt: Seller Assistant now carries persistent memory of each seller's business... New Seller Assistant workflows give sellers the power to continuously monitor and execute routine tasks like restocking and pricing adjustments

key_facts.fact: The launch came days after Amazon blocked Meta's Muse shopping agent from its store; Amazon still decides which AI platforms the plugin supports.
key_facts.excerpt: The announcement comes days after Amazon blocked Meta's Muse, a new AI agent that can shop on behalf of consumers, from its store.

key_facts.fact: The plugin is in beta in Amazon's US stores, with international expansion to follow.
key_facts.excerpt: The plugin is in beta for sellers in Amazon's US stores, with international expansion to follow.

stories.headline: Basecamp Research raises $140M, with Anthropic and Nvidia backing its AI-designed medicines

key_facts.fact: London-based Basecamp Research announced a $140M Series C on September 23, 2026, led by S32, to train a new generation of EDEN models and advance AI-designed therapeutics toward the clinic.
key_facts.excerpt: Basecamp Research... today announced a $140M Series C financing to train a new generation of EDEN models and advance a pipeline of AI-designed therapeutics towards clinical development.

key_facts.fact: Participants include Anthropic's Anthology Fund (a new investor), Nvidia, the NATO Innovation Fund and The Rockefeller Foundation.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's venture arm, NVentures, a returning investor and Anthropic's Anthology Fund, a partnership between Anthropic and US VC Menlo Ventures, a new investor, also joined the round.

key_facts.fact: The company has raised $225M in total; it raised a $60M Series B in 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup, which has raised $225m in total, said it will use the funding to train a new generation of its AI models

key_facts.fact: The first pipeline focus is in vivo cell therapy; EDEN models can design cell and gene therapies, enzymes and peptides.
key_facts.excerpt: Funding will advance a pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, starting with in vivo cell therapy... The EDEN models' capabilities include designing cell and gene therapies, enzymes and peptides.

key_facts.fact: Basecamp's training data is the Trillion Gene Atlas, built with Nvidia, Anthropic, PacBio and Ultima Genomics; the dataset is meant to grow roughly a hundredfold to over one quadrillion tokens in the next 18 months.
key_facts.excerpt: Over the next year and a half, the dataset is supposed to grow roughly a hundredfold, passing one quadrillion tokens.

stories.headline: AI training-data startup Micro1 raises $100M+ at $4B, eight times its value a year ago

key_facts.fact: Micro1 raised more than $100M at a $4B valuation, according to two people familiar with the deal, as reported by Forbes on September 22.
key_facts.excerpt: Micro1, has raised a fresh funding round of more than $100 million at a valuation of $4 billion, according to two people familiar with the deal.

key_facts.fact: The valuation is up eightfold from $500M in September 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The fundraise catapults Micro1's valuation eightfold in just a year, up from $500 million in September 2025.

key_facts.fact: Two frontier AI labs and two xAI co-founders participated; customers include frontier labs, Microsoft, Amazon and robotics firm 1X.
key_facts.excerpt: The company counts frontier AI labs, Microsoft, Amazon and robotics companies like 1X as customers. Several of them are participating in the new round, including two frontier labs and two of xAI's cofounders

key_facts.fact: Founder Ali Ansari, 25, pivoted Micro1 from AI recruiting to supplying expert-created training data; it passed $100M in annualized revenue by December 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: By December 2025, eight months into that pivot, Micro1 had crossed $100 million in annualized revenue.

key_facts.fact: In August 2026 TechCrunch reported Micro1's gross annual run rate had grown from $100M to $500M over eight months.
key_facts.excerpt: expanded its gross annual run rate from $100 million to $500 million over the past eight months

stories.headline: Ema raises $77M Series B for 'AI employees' that run HR, IT and finance work

key_facts.fact: Ema raised a $77M Series B led by Creaegis, with Accel, S32 and Prosus increasing their investments, bringing total funding to $140M.
key_facts.excerpt: Ema... today announced a $77 million Series B funding round led by Creaegis, with Accel, S32 and Prosus all increasing their existing investments in the company. The round brings Ema's total funding to $140 million

key_facts.fact: The round more than quadruples Ema's valuation from its 2024 round; the company declined to disclose the figure, and the round was all primary equity.
key_facts.excerpt: more than quadruples its valuation from its last funding round in 2024. (Ema declined to disclose its latest valuation.) The round consisted entirely of primary equity

key_facts.fact: Ema says revenue grew 50x over the past 24 months.
key_facts.excerpt: The company has grown revenue 50X over the past 24 months

key_facts.fact: Ema has more than 50 active enterprise deals and over 1 million active enterprise users; customers include NTT DATA, Hitachi, ADP, PwC, Google, KPMG, Wipro and Microsoft.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup has more than 50 active enterprise deals, as well as over 1 million active enterprise users... Its customers include NTT DATA, Hitachi, ADP, PwC, Google, KPMG, Wipro, and Microsoft.

key_facts.fact: Wipro deployed an Ema-powered assistant for more than 240,000 employees in 65 countries, cutting IT support tickets by 50%.
key_facts.excerpt: Wipro Ltd., which has deployed an Ema-powered AI assistant for more than 240,000 employees spread across 65 countries... leading to a 50% reduction in the number of IT support tickets.

key_facts.fact: Ema was founded in 2023 by former Google and Coinbase executive Surojit Chatterjee and ex-Okta executive Souvik Sen.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2023 by former Google and Coinbase executive Surojit Chatterjee and ex-Okta executive Souvik Sen
